name: io.github.Servosity/google-workspace-mcp
title: Google Workspace MCP
description: Cross-client Google Workspace admin: 2SV gaps, license waste, sharing drift, safe offboarding.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Default client tenant (from google-workspace-cli tenants list) for tool calls that name no tenant, including sql, search and raw API calls. Set it when more than one tenant is registered: without it sql and search refuse to answer.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to exactly 1 to hide offboard, sync, export, tenants test, tenants remove, workflow archive, learnings forget and learnings reject, and refuse every non-GET API call (true or yes are ignored). Leave blank for the full tool set.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional single-organization OAuth access token with Admin SDK scopes, for use instead of registering client tenants. Leave blank once tenants are registered.

environmentVariables.name: ADMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional alternate name for GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_TOKEN. Leave blank.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the https://admin.googleapis.com host, for testing against a mock server. Leave blank.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Google requests. Leave blank.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Has no effect for this connector (not a Google Workspace tenant). Leave blank.
